t: You're looking at Imperial Chemical House on Millbank, near the west end of Lambeth Bridge. It was built between 1927 and 1929 as the headquarters of the newly created Imperial Chemical Industries. It is Grade II listed and designed in the neoclassical style of the inter-war years. The architect was Sir Frank Baines, who had been chief architect at the Office of Works until 1927. Next door, across Horseferry Road, is Thames House, which Baines also designed and which was built at the same time. Together the two buildings make a matching pair.
